args.laneNotes:
ENV (lane env). Final: re-judge 8.2 (round-1 judge 6.6), only minors and nits left. Default: the Blender bake v9 real-geometry environment (no doubled mountains from any pointer view; ridge seam, specks and dark line fixed; EnvEdge silhouette pass; back-face texel patch; summit wisp card). The lake default is the re-aimed plate lake: the planar mirror lake exists but is opt-in (?envlake=mirror) because it lost the floe / iceberg reflection columns and cost 1.21x frame time with a moving camera. Switches: ?env=projected (the round-10 projected plates, the way back), ?envfix=0 (the build judge 1 judged), ?envlake=mirror|plate, ?envedge=0, ?envtex=s2, ?envwisp=0, ?envlakecorr=0, ?envmirrorrate=1, ?envlod=bias, ?envside=front. Open: T0 skylines are raw aliased mesh edges (minor); a pre-existing pale floe tip cut by the bottom edge in phone portrait (minor); nits (GPU memory holds bake + all plates; faint dashed row on the lake; 1-px outlines along silhouettes in diff maps). New assets in public/hero: env_baked.glb / .json, baked/*.webp (incl. v9g way-back textures), sky_world.exr, wisp_card.exr, lake_corr.png; new code world/EnvEdge.ts, world/LakeMirror.ts; pipeline scripts bake_env_m9.py, comp_env_m9.py, encode_env_m9.py, encode_sky_m9.py, render_plates_m9.py, run_bake_m9.zsh, finalize_bake_m9.zsh, render_sky_equirect.py (rewritten).

HOLD (lane hold) = THE USER'S PRIORITY. Their words (15 Nov 09:05): the two middle rings did not rotate, only repeated a back-and-forth move; the two outer rings were not seamless; the outer rings must keep rotating in their rest direction, in slow motion, while opening. Default: the rotating hold (step 3 + fix round): rings A and B keep their rest-direction idle tumble with the clock eased to 0.25 while A's quarters move 0.6 m out along their radials and B's halves split 0.1 m, plus a flex offset along A's axis and a frame guard; C and D rotate continuously; the camera lunge timing matches the reference; ring A's in-plane phase at rest is -22.5 deg so its quarter joints match F000. User-priority gates, H-G2..H-G5 and perf pass by the fixer's check. Judge (step 3, before the fix) 7.0 with one major: the opened hold read as a nested swirl round a bare white orb; the fix attacked its root causes, but A2's absolute shape rows still cannot all pass while A keeps its tumble (A never faces the hold camera). The re-judge after the fix was cut off by the usage limit (not run). Switches: ?hold=r10 (round-10 hold, bit-identical), ?hold=r11a (the step-2 A2 key-frame arrangement), ?spin=s3 (the step-3 rotating hold before the fix), ?aphase=r10 (round-10 ring A phase). Open: narrow portrait gets almost no hold zoom; the orb reads as a bright disc where no ring covers it; shards fly through the opened set; C / D return to their idle nod about 1 s after the release. New code: hero/HoldR11.ts; changes in Rings.ts, Choreography.ts, CameraRig.ts, HeroEngine.ts.

ICE (lane ice). Default: the round-11 ice converged on the Cycles twin of the artist's materials (smooth tilt field instead of the Voronoi chisel, IceColor tint once per pass, the orb in the reflection lookup and its mirror image in the lake, lobe growth per internal bounce, one-sided critical-angle smoothing, the twin's orb limb, ICE_R11 / ORB_R11 / SHARD_R11 paths). Judge 7.0 before the fix; the fix round is partial: the aliased camouflage islands are fixed (artefact gate passes) and values improved; still open: no frost texture (needs a Blender-baked frost texture), p06 ring A 5 L too dark and ring B less blue, busy hold-orb plasma, shallow top rim lines, a faint 2-3 px speck on the p06 arc, q03 hard steps 1.25x round 10, T1 hold frame time at the +10 % limit. T0 keeps the round-10 hero. Switches: ?ice=r10 (round-10 ice, orb and shards exactly), ?ice=r11a (the build judge 1 judged). The re-judge after the fix was cut off by the usage limit (not run). Changes in IceMaterial.ts, Orb.ts, Shards.ts (if any), Rings.ts, RenderPipeline.ts.

LEAD DECISIONS for this integration: every lane's new behaviour is the default (env 8.2; the hold is the user's explicit priority; ice 7.0 against the round-10 ice lens 6.2). The verifier and the following QC panel judge hold and ice on the integrated build in place of the cut re-judges. Expected overlaps: hero/Rings.ts (hold rewrote the hold motion and ring A's phase; ice added material hooks), HeroEngine.ts (hold and env), RenderPipeline.ts (ice). The all-round-10 way back is ?env=projected&hold=r10&aphase=r10&ice=r10. The user is at the Mac right now on battery: the slot is in light mode (2 heavy jobs, background QoS) - use SLOT_BG=0 only for timing runs.
